claims.originating_goal: Repair the deployed Ecosystem Chat semantic failure where a reconstructed response to “What time is it?” returned unrelated fixed governance prose.
claims.claim_expires_when: Source/path ownership released after validated merge. Runtime re-observation remains a non-owning evidence predicate and must not block unrelated shared-client repairs.
expected_evidence: shared device-local clock intent produces current device time
clock response carries a SHA-256 deterministic-execution receipt
captured epoch, locale, and timezone reconstruct the same output in the same execution
receipt states model_execution=false and grants no authority
unsupported ordinary prompts do not emit unrelated governance prose
deployed iPhone response and machine-visible receipt are observed
collision_boundaries: Do not duplicate the shared LLM-adapter runtime
Do not claim the reference model is a production LLM
Do not create another primary conversational surface
claims.next_task_after_release: Retain the clock runtime re-observation predicate without owning shared conversational files; permit collision-free semantic routing repairs.

observed_gap.prior_behavior: The deterministic clock returned before executeDeviceRaw() and emitted no receipt, so it could answer correctly but could not satisfy the claim's reconstruction-evidence predicate.
observed_gap.repair: Emit and persist a separately typed deterministic-capability receipt reconstructed from the captured epoch, locale, and timezone; do not describe it as model execution.
